reason: In method1 every occurrence of the key is replaced with the value, while method2 uses the length of the key to advance the search index but replaces the key with the value. When the value is longer than the key, method2’s search index is advanced by the value’s length, causing it to skip an overlapping occurrence that method1 would still replace. For the input text="abcab", key="ab", value="abc", method1 replaces the first "ab" and then the second, yielding "abccab", whereas method2 replaces the first "ab", then continues searching from the end of the inserted value and replaces the second "ab" as well, producing "abccabc".
